aggregation: per-game metrics on the concatenation of the game's dense records (distinct period id per record, breaks preserved); split/overall = unweighted mean over games; feed_v2 = mean of 2 realizations per game
bootstrap_method: paired percentile bootstrap over games, 2,000 draws, seed 20261101; games resampled with replacement within the group (valid 9, test 10, all 19); statistic = mean over games of the per-game difference
